page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Greek paradigm tables set as a column of forms beneath the Latin text; a marginal mark at the right of the first irregular line; running head at top; page number at top right.

main_text.p: Irregularis comparatio est, in quâ comparativus & superlativus non tantum à Nomine adjectivo veniunt; aut etiam aliter finiūt, quàm per πρὸς & τάτος.
Estque septemplex. Veniunt enim comparativus & superlativus:
I. à Nominibus adjectivis; quorum nonnulla & regulariter, & irregulariter comparantur, ut:

page.notes: Greek forms in the paradigm columns are transcribed from a handwritten-looking print with uncertain accents; some letters in the βεχαδ- forms and the final ἡδύς line are doubtful. The mark at the right of the irregular-comparison line is a printed or manuscript mark, not text. Show-through and stains omitted.
